original: .... 정말이지 가끔은 주인영감이 어떻게 되어 버렸으면 하는 생각이 든다니까.
chinese_reference: ……真是的，有时候我真希望老板那个老头出点什么事。
target: ... Honestly, sometimes I wish something would happen to that old boss of ours.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 나는 비프로스트의 학자입니다. 이곳 다카마는 자료 조사차 와 있지요.
chinese_reference: 我是比弗罗斯特的学者。来达卡马是为了调查资料。
target: I'm a scholar from Bifrost. I've come to Dakama to conduct research.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 하필 시간을 내서 자료 조사를 하러 오니까 이렇게 경기가 경직되어 있어서...
chinese_reference: 好不容易抽出时间来调查，偏偏碰上这里经济萧条……
target: I finally found time to come here for research, only to find the economy in such a slump...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 뭐, 자료 조사하는데에 문제야 없겠지만, 사람이 밥만 먹고 사는 것도 아니고, 이거 도데체 자료조사 외에는 아무것도 할 수 없으니...
chinese_reference: 虽说调查资料没什么问题，可人也不是光吃饭就能活的。在这里，除了查资料，根本什么都做不了……
target: Well, it won't interfere with my research, but a person needs more than food to live. There's absolutely nothing to do here except research...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 난 커티스의 장교요. 이곳에는 연락할 사람이 있어서 왔지.
chinese_reference: 我是柯蒂斯的军官。来这里是为了和人接头。
target: I'm an officer from Curtis. I've come to meet a contact here.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 자세한 것은 군사기밀이라 가르쳐 줄 수 없소만, 투르제국과의 싸움에 결정적인 도움을 줄 수 있는 정보요.
chinese_reference: 细节涉及军事机密，不能告诉你，但这份情报能对抗击图尔帝国起到决定性的帮助。
target: The details are a military secret, but the information could be decisive in our fight against the Tur Empire.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 며칠정도 머무르다가 통행증이 나오면 팬드래건의 수도로 곧장 갈 생각이오.
chinese_reference: 我打算再待几天，拿到通行证后，就直接前往潘德拉根的首都。
target: I'll stay a few days, then head straight for Pendragon's capital once my travel permit comes through.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 이제 귀화한지 1년이 다 되가오. 1년이 지나면 팬드래건 내로 들어갈 수 있는 허가증이 나오지.
chinese_reference: 入籍快满一年了。等满一年，就能拿到进入潘德拉根境内的许可证。
target: It's been almost a year since I became a citizen. After a year, I'll receive a permit to enter Pendragon proper.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 왜 투르족을 버리고 팬드래건으로 귀화했느냐고? 사랑을 위해서요. 나는 그녀를 위해서는 목숨도 버릴 수 있거늘, 하물며 국적이야...
chinese_reference: 问我为什么离开图尔族，加入潘德拉根国籍？为了爱情。为了她，我连性命都可以舍弃，何况国籍……
target: Why did I leave the Tur people and become a citizen of Pendragon? For love. I'd give my life for her, let alone my nationality...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 난 평생을 이곳에서 일했어. 돈도 꽤 모았고, 이제 손녀딸에게 이 가게를 물려줄려고 하지.
chinese_reference: 我一辈子都在这里干活，也攒了不少钱，如今打算把这家店传给孙女。
target: I've worked here my whole life. I've saved quite a bit, and now I plan to leave this shop to my granddaughter.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 하지만, 역시 여자 혼자서 가게를 운영하는 것은 어려워. 손녀딸의 남편감을 찾아야 하는데... 어디 좋은 남자 없을까?
chinese_reference: 不过，女人一个人经营店铺终究不容易。得替孙女找个丈夫才行……有没有什么好小伙子呢？
target: But it's hard for a woman to run a shop alone. I need to find my granddaughter a husband... Know any good young men?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 할아버지는 왜 언니를 그렇게 시집보내지 못해 안달인 거지?

notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

target: The meeting room is always ready for use whenever you need it.

target: The meeting room is the heart of Zephyr Falcon. I put my heart and soul into keeping it clean.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

chinese_reference: 会议室是我们西风之隼基地里/n装饰最华丽的房间。
target: The meeting room is the most lavishly decorated room/nin our Zephyr Falcon base.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 현재 우리 제피르 팰컨의 사기는 최고조입니다만,/n적들도 점점 더 강해지는 것 같습니다.

notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

chinese_reference: 尤其是罗恩的弗雷德里克将军麾下的军队，/n实在很难对付。
target: General Frederick's army in Lowen/nis particularly difficult to fight.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 가끔가다 주점 벽 한편에서 이상한 소리가/n들려오는 경우가 있습니다./n술에 너무 취해서 그런가?
chinese_reference: 有时会听见酒馆的一面墙里/n传来奇怪的声音。/n是我喝得太醉了吗？
target: Sometimes I hear strange noises/nfrom one of the tavern walls./nAm I drinking too much?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 제피르 팰컨에 들어오기 전에는 저는/n카라카스에서 좀도둑질을 했었지요./n하지만 지금은 완전히 손을 씻은 상태입니다.
chinese_reference: 加入西风之隼以前，/n我在加拉加斯做过些小偷小摸的事。/n不过，现在已经彻底洗手不干了。
target: Before I joined Zephyr Falcon,/nI was a petty thief in Caracas./nBut I've gone completely straight now.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 흥… 저 녀석이 손을 씻었다는 것은/n메주를 콩으로 쑨다고 해도 안 믿을 겁니다.
chinese_reference: 哼……那家伙说自己洗手不干，/n就算他说太阳从东边升起，我也不信。
target: Hmph... Him, gone straight? I wouldn't trust a word out of his mouth,/neven if he told me the sun rose in the east.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 요새 내무반에서 없어지는 물건은/n꼭 저 녀석이 돈을 받고 팔고 있다고요.

target: Whenever something goes missing from the barracks lately,/nthat fellow ends up selling it.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 우리 제피르 팰컨의 명성은 드높고/n사기는 하늘을 찌를 듯 합니다.

chinese_reference: 如今，我们不再只是复仇者或义贼，/n而是要为这个帝国带来变革的组织。
target: We're no longer just a band of avengers or noble outlaws./nWe're an organization working to transform this empire.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 로우엔의 프레데릭 경의 군대는 정말로 상대하기/n싫은 군대입니다. 그들의 정예 사수는 정확한 발포와/n겨냥을 하고, 그들의 검사의 손은 매섭지요.
chinese_reference: 罗恩的弗雷德里克大人的部队，是我最不愿碰上的对手。/n他们的精锐射手瞄得准、打得稳，/n剑士的身手也十分凌厉。
target: Lord Frederick's army in Lowen is one force/nI'd rather not face. Their elite marksmen aim and fire/nwith precision, and their swordsmen are formidable.
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 사실, 다른 영주도 그와 같다면/n우리가 존재할 이유가 없겠죠./n안 그렇습니까…
chinese_reference: 说真的，要是其他领主也像他那样，/n我们就没有存在的必要了。/n不是吗……
target: In fact, if all the other lords were like him,/nthere'd be no reason for us to exist./nWould there...?
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

original: 제가 이곳에 들어온 것은 우리 가족…전체가 몰살당했기 때문이지. /n그것도 영주한테…
chinese_reference: 我会加入这里，是因为我的家人……全被杀了。/n而且，下手的还是领主……
target: I joined because my family... my entire family was slaughtered. /nBy our own lord, no less...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.

target: I've lived for revenge alone./nWithout that, I'd have no reason to go on living...
notes: Korean read alongside Chinese. Source-specific royal titles, voyage frequency and NPC views retained. Minor names provisional.
